content.rendered:
Hey there! Welcome to Seattle Northwest Homes, where real estate dreams come to life! We’re thrilled to have you here and excited to share our story with you.

Our Journey Begins

Our journey began with a deep passion for real estate and an unwavering love for the beautiful Seattle Northwest area. We, a group of local real estate enthusiasts, came together with a common mission – to create a real estate experience like no other. With years of combined expertise in the industry and a shared love for our community, we knew we had something special to offer.

The Heart of Our Approach

At the heart of our approach is YOU! Yes, you heard it right. You, the homebuyer, the seller, the dreamer – you are the reason we do what we do. We believe that finding or selling a home should be an exciting and fulfilling experience, not a stressful one. That’s why we’ve built our foundation on personalized service, transparency, and genuine care for every client we serve.

More Than Just Real Estate

For us, it’s more than just real estate transactions. It’s about creating lasting relationships, being a trusted advisor, and being there for you every step of the way. Whether you’re a first-time buyer, a seasoned investor, or a family looking to move into the neighborhood, we’re here to listen, to understand, and to guide you towards your real estate goals.

Local Market Experts

We know Seattle Northwest like the back of our hands! This is our home, and we take immense pride in being local market experts. From the bustling city streets to the serene waterfront, we’ve explored every nook and cranny, and we can’t wait to show you around.

Your Success is Our Success

Nothing makes us happier than seeing your real estate dreams come true. Whether it’s helping you find that perfect home that makes your heart skip a beat or securing the best deal for your property sale, your success is our success, and we celebrate every victory with you.

Join Our Family

When you choose Seattle Northwest Homes, you become a part of our family. We promise to treat you with the utmost respect, care, and integrity because that’s what family is all about.

Let’s Begin Your Journey

So, what are you waiting for? Let’s embark on this exciting journey together! Whether you’re ready to buy, sell, or simply curious about the market, we’re here to help. Leave us a message now – we can’t wait to meet you!

Thank you for choosing Seattle Northwest Homes – where dreams find a place to call home. Let’s make magic happen!

Warmest regards,
The Seattle Northwest Homes Team

content.rendered:
Who we are

Our website address is: https://seattlenorthwesthomes.com.

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Seattle Northwest Homes

Search Smarter

Finding A Home Has Never Been Easy!
Selling
Buying

Why Seattle Northwest Homes?

Choosing Seattle Northwest Homes is an exceptional decision when it comes to buying or selling properties in the Seattle area. Here's why:

Local Expertise

We have an in-depth understanding of the Seattle real estate market. Our team possesses extensive knowledge of diverse neighborhoods, market trends, and pricing fluctuations, enabling us to provide accurate advice and make well-informed decisions.

Personalized Approach

We believe in providing personalized services tailored to each client's unique needs and preferences. Whether you are looking for your dream home or seeking to sell your property quickly and at the best price, we'll work closely with you to achieve your goals.

Trusted Reputation

Seattle Northwest Homes has earned a reputation for integrity, professionalism, and exceptional customer service. Our satisfied clients and positive testimonials are a testament to our dedication to exceeding expectations.

Comprehensive Services

From property evaluations and market analysis to negotiations and paperwork, we offer a comprehensive suite of real estate services. Our goal is to streamline the buying or selling process and ensure a smooth and stress-free experience.

Extensive Network

Over the years, we've built a vast network of industry professionals, including lenders, inspectors, contractors, and more. This network allows us to connect you with the right experts who can assist you at every step of the real estate journey.

Transparent Communication

Communication is the cornerstone of our business. We keep you informed throughout the process, promptly addressing your queries and concerns, and ensuring you're always aware of the progress.

Local Community Involvement

As a company deeply rooted in the Seattle Northwest area, we are committed to giving back to the community. We actively participate in local initiatives and charitable events, fostering a sense of belonging and support.

Client-Centric Focus

Your satisfaction is our priority. We measure our success not only by successful transactions but also by building lasting relationships with our clients. Your happiness and success are what drives us to excel.

Hassle-Free Experience

By entrusting your real estate needs to Seattle Northwest Homes, you can rest assured that we'll handle the complexities of the process, allowing you to focus on other important aspects of your life.

For Buyers

Acquiring a property is probably the most significant financial choice you will ever undertake. Regardless of whether you're a first-time buyer or a seasoned one, this decision demands meticulous consideration. Seattle Northwest Homes aims to assist you in making this decision by providing an extensive array of properties available in the area. Simply inform us about your preferences, and we'll promptly provide you with a tailored list.
Let Us Know Your Dream Property

For Sellers

So, you've decided to sell your property. Before anything else, take some time to think about why you want to sell and when you should do it. We'll also consider the market conditions and other factors related to your decision. Just share the details about your property, and we'll do our best to assess it for you.
Submit Your Property
